title: Diagonalization of skew-Hermitian dual quaternion matrices and $φ$-Hermitian dual quaternion matrices
summary: In this article, we present the diagonalization of skew-Hermitian dual quaternion matrices in the sense of unitary equivalence. For a unit quaternion $φ$, we also obtain the diagonalization result of $φ$-Hermitian dual quaternion matrices in the sense of unitary $φ$-congruence, which generalizes the Autonne--Takagi factorization of symmetric complex matrices and $φ$-Hermitian quaternion matrices.
